Round 2 (§2): objectui#12623, #12612, #12620 and #12611 landed; the `next.2` consumer bump objectui#12626 (filed and claimed by this seat) landed too. Round 3 on the maintainer's 「补」: objectui#12627 landed, and objectui#12626 landed as PR objectui#12648 (expedited on the maintainer's word); objectui#12608's objectui half landed as PR objectui#12658; objectui#12604 landed as PR objectui#12687 (`f0e760a`). objectui#12653 landed as PR objectui#12699 (`e6175b5`), so every eager-closure ceiling is 20% higher. objectui#12606 landed as PR objectui#12662 (`c41ce3f`) under ruling C. objectui#12673 landed as PR objectui#12738 (`b393152`) under ruling A. objectui#12701 landed as PR objectui#12748 (`e219a3d`). objectui#12705 landed as PR objectui#12754 (`80863ad`). objectui#12695 landed as PR objectui#12773 (`0171c24`). objectui#12702 landed as PR objectui#12776 (`4857cd2`). objectui#12707 landed as PR objectui#12792 (`2368d7a`). objectui#12742 landed as PR objectui#12813 (`5483297`). objectui#12787 landed as PR objectui#12814 (`6e4f144`). objectui#12708 landed as PR objectui#12822 (`4839f5c`). objectui#12724's partial claim landed as PR objectui#12841 (`ac59073`); the card is back in `pm:queue` for its v2 payload rows. objectui#12808 landed as PR objectui#12840 (`5d69b0e`). objectui#12794 landed as PR objectui#12846 (`0812a19`). objectui#12816 landed as PR objectui#12850 (`4b3d6ed`). objectui#12809 landed as PR objectui#12855 (`84b8ffa`). objectui#12795 landed as PR objectui#12856 (`e43a162`) and objectui#12704 as PR objectui#12857 (`db4417e`, ruling B′). objectui#12297 landed as PR objectui#12861 (`8106db1`). objectui#12848 landed as PR objectui#12864 (`fb17003`) and objectui#12851 as PR objectui#12865 (`473e5a0`). It was re-dispatched at 03:48, when objectui#12816 landed: `session_01BxWPtU5qnbTX3RoZJqNSza`, claim `6229218246`, the same branch, `Clause-②: no`. objectui#12704 (the dashboard KPI tiles' height) was ruled B by the maintainer (「12704 同意」, ruling `6227971389`): the metadata's `layout.h` is corrected in objectstack-ai/objectstack#24126 and objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2135, and this card is re-scoped to one objectui regression pin. Decisions go on cards, on the maintainer's 「需要我决策的开决策卡」; the skill wording is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23934. objectui#12406 and #12486 were taken by `domain:ui` seat 1. The batch drops to 3 after these. objectui#12634 (this seat's objectui#12612 pin in the merge queue) closed as fixed on `main`. The console-home cards objectui#12602, #12604 and #12605 are held behind seat 1's objectui#12601.
